page.layout: One column of running text. Printed page number 172 at top left, running head PRÆLECTIONES at top right. Two centred headings: THESIS. and DEMONSTRATIO PRI-MÆ PARTIS. Catchword at the bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Joan.4.23. Cumq; vox affectus fidelis in corde index fit, precatio eximo corde ad Deum fusa, clamor dicitur. Exodi 14.15. Quid clamas ad me? 1.Sam.7.8. Dixerunt Israelitae ad Samuelem: Ne sileas pro nobis clamando ad Jehouam Deum nostrum, ut eripiat nos de manu Peliftim.
Obseruetur autem αὔξησις[?] ducta a consideratione tum afflictionum, tum loci, in quo morabatur Propheta per illud tri noctium: sed hac de re paulo post dicetur.
main_text.head: THESIS.
main_text.p: Ut fides non nisi ad Jehouam clamat: sic de exauditione plene persuasa est.
main_text.head: DEMONSTRATIO PRI-mæ partis.
main_text.p: Fides neminem alium, quàm eum in quo tanquam summo bonorum omnium auctore suauissimè acquiescit, invocat. juxta illud Pauli: Quomodo invocabunt eum, in quem non crediderint? Roman.10.14.
Credit autem Deo, & acquiescit in Jehouah solo. Nec enim fidei cultus ulli creaturae competit, sed soli Creatori: secundum illud Apostoli: Nam iccirco etiam fatigamur & probris afficimur, quòd

page.notes: Greek word after "autem" is set in a small, worn face; the reading αὔξησις is uncertain. The catchword "spere" ends in a mark that may be an abbreviation; read with doubt. "Peliftim" is printed as such and left as printed. Long s throughout read as plain s; u/v and i/j normalised as instructed.
